subject: Dedicated commit structure and Hosted→Dedicated conversion terms
messages:
From: Ben Carter <ben.carter@redwood.com>
To: Dana Shaw <dana.shaw@acme.com>
Cc: Matthew Cho <matthew.cho@acme.com>
Date: Sun, 10 May 2026 08:12:00 -0700
Subject: Proposal: Dedicated commit sizing + conversion credits from Hosted API

Hi Dana —

Great speaking yesterday. As promised, I put together a concise proposal for converting Acme’s current Hosted usage to a Dedicated GPU pool while preserving throughput and giving you credit for prior Hosted spend. High-level summary below; attached is the full pricing deck (RI_Dedicated_Pricing_v3.pdf).

- Suggested GPU pool: 4x A100-equivalent nodes (estimated sustained throughput: ~180 tokens/sec for your 2k median seq length workloads; peak autoscale headroom to 240 tokens/sec)
- Commit: 12 months reserved capacity, 24/7 baseline.
- Pricing: list price is $X/month for this pool; we can offer structured discounts for multi-year or higher commits (see table in deck).
- Conversion credits: to offset Hosted spend, we propose conversion credits equal to 50% of your trailing 3 months of Hosted invoices, applied as one-time offsets against the first 3 monthly invoices on Dedicated (max credit cap shown in deck).
- Commit offsets / bridge months: If timing causes overlap between Hosted invoices and Dedicated commits, we’ll grant up to 2 bridge months of capacity credits to smooth the transition. Bridge months can be used either as usage credits or applied to the final month of the first billing cycle — flexible based on your procurement preference.
- Throughput guarantees: SLO target 99th-pctl tail latency under 300 ms for interactive calls; we’ll include burst capacity to preserve P95 throughput during model warmups.

Next steps I suggest: 1) confirm pool sizing, 2) agree on conversion credit % and bridge months, 3) sign redlined contract. If you’d like, I can get Finance to create a committed quote with the 12-month and optional 24-month pricing rows.

Thanks — looking forward to getting Acme onto Dedicated.

Best,
Ben Carter
Account Executive, Redwood Inference

3) If we start Dedicated mid-quarter, can commit offsets be pro-rated?

Also, the throughput and latency numbers look reasonable. I’ll loop in Procurement after we align on conversion math.

Date: Mon, 11 May 2026 11:22:00 -0700

Ben —

Thanks for the summary. Commercial guidance: lean into conversion credits but protect revenue. Recommended terms I’d approve: 

- Conversion credit: 60% of trailing 3 months of Hosted spend, applied as a fixed one-time invoice credit split across the first 3 monthly invoices on Dedicated. Cap the credit at 25% of first-year committed value. This balances a meaningful concession while preventing outsized write-offs.
- Bridge months: grant up to 2 bridge months as invoice credits (explicit credit entries) — do not waive final invoice. Make bridge months non-transferable and expire if not used within first 90 days.
- Discount: approve up to 15% off list for the first 12 months in exchange for signature within 5 business days. After signature window, go back to 10% or standard list.
- Pro-ration: yes, prorate the first month of committed capacity if start date is mid-billing-cycle; do not apply conversion credits to prorated portion.

Approve Ben to present the above; have Legal pre-load a redline with the credit tables and expiry language.

-Lauren
VP, Commercial Operations
Redwood Inference

Hi Dana —

Appreciate the quick turnaround and great questions. Per our internal guidance, here are updated, concrete terms for Acme’s review: 

1) Conversion credits: 60% of your trailing 3 months of Hosted invoices (we’ll use the average monthly Hosted invoice across that window). Credits will be applied as invoice credits split evenly across Dedicated invoices 1–3. Max credit cap = 25% of first-year committed value (to avoid disproportionate offsets).

2) Bridge months: we will provide up to 2 bridge months as invoice credits (explicit credit line items). Bridge credits must be requested within the first 90 days; they can be applied as usage credits or used to offset the relevant monthly invoice. We do not waive the final invoice.

3) Pro-ration: if Dedicated starts mid-billing-cycle, first month will be pro-rated; conversion credits will be applied to full monthly invoices only (not to pro-rated partial-month charges).

4) Discount: we can offer a 15% discount on list pricing for the first 12 months if Acme signs within 5 business days of this email.

Attached is a redlined contract (ACME_Contract_Redline.docx) showing credit tables and expiration language. If that looks good, I’ll have our Legal/Finance push a committed quote and DocuSign link.

Thanks — happy to hop on a 20-minute call if you prefer to finalize verbally.

Best,
Ben Carter
